text: The Vatican placed Stendhal's The Red and the Black on the Index in 1864, and Pope Leo XIII reconfirmed the decision in 1897. A decree of 1864 is recorded in the Index Librorum Prohibitorum, 1877 edition. In 1964, General Justino Alves Bastos ordered the burning of all 'subversive books' in Rio Grande do Sul, which included the novel.
meta_description: The Red and the Black by Stendhal: placed on the Index in 1864, reconfirmed in 1897; burned as a subversive book in Rio Grande do Sul in 1964.
